verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own integration docs say it can map users with access and check whether they have offboarded from the organization, and it documents access-check monitoring and access reviews, which covers part of the leaver-lost-access side. Nothing in the evidence shows HR-system sync, onboarding checklists, or proof that new hires completed training. missing for 10: HR-synced onboarding/offboarding checklists, training-completion tracking for new hires, documented automated deprovisioning evidence per leaver, independent or hands-on corroboration.
